name: Offer Letter
body:
Applicant Name: {{salutation}} {{full_name}}	                           	           	                                      OFFER LETTER
Applicant Email: {{email}}    			                                                    {{letter_no}}

                                                                                                                                                                       Date: {{date}}

To,
{{salutation}} {{full_name}}
{{address}}

Subject: Offer of Employment
Dear Mr./Ms. {{first_name}},

We are pleased to offer you the position of {{designation}} in {{department}} with Jaikalki Technology Pvt Ltd, effective from {{date_of_joining}}. This offer is based on your qualifications, experience, and our discussions.

Your total annual CTC will be ₹{{ctc_amount}}/- (Amount in Words), details of which will be shared in the salary annexure in the Appointment Letter. Statutory deductions will be applicable as per company policy and government regulations.

This offer is subject to the successful verification of your documents, references, and any background checks deemed necessary.

You will be on a probation period of 6 months. Upon successful completion and performance evaluation, your employment will be confirmed in writing. Your working hours and weekly offs will follow the company’s standard schedule. Leave entitlements will be governed by company policy, applicable from your date of joining.

Kindly submit all the documents listed below at the time of your joining:
Government ID Proof (Aadhar and PAN Card) self-attested.
Educational Certificates.
Latest/Previous Employment Offer/Appointment Letter containing Salary Annexure
Latest/Previous Employment Increment Letter (If any)
3-month Salary slip annual salary details from the Latest/Previous Employer
Experience/Relieving Letter or acceptance of your resignation letter from your Latest/Previous Employer
3 passport-size photographs (The photographs should not be older than 6 months from the date of receipt of this letter)

We welcome you aboard. We expect you to join us on or before {{date_of_joining}}, in line with our discussion
with you.

The company looks for a long-term association with all its employees and expects the same from you.
Again, congratulations and welcome to Jaikalki Technology Pvt Ltd.

With best wishes,
For Jaikalki Technology Pvt Ltd	          	                                                                      I confirm and accept the above and
                                         I will join on {{date_of_joining}}

[ABC]	                     __________________________
Director                               		                                                                       [Candidate Name & Signature]

name: Appointment Letter
body:
{{letter_no}}                                                                                               Date: {{date}}

{{salutation}} {{full_name}},
Emp. Code: {{employee_code}}
{{address}}

Subject: Appointment Letter

Dear {{salutation}} {{full_name}},

With reference to your application and subsequent interview, we are pleased to appoint you in the capacity of “{{designation}}”, with effect from {{date_of_joining}}, subject to the following terms and conditions.

REMUNERATION:

Your emoluments would be Rs. {{ctc_amount}}/- (Amount in Words) per annum. The details are provided in the annexure attached herewith. You would be eligible for all the statutory benefits as provided by law.

CONFIDENTIALITY:

During the term of your employment with us, you will come across voluminous information relating to the database and secret credentials. You shall keep all the information received by you or made known to you during the course of the employment confidential, and you shall not divulge any such information even after you cease to be the employee of the company. The company shall be entitled to adopt legal proceedings in the event of a breach of the said confidential information..

ASSIGNMENT:

You will assign to the Company your entire right, title & interest in any invention or improvement that you may make, solely or jointly with others, in the course of your employment with the Company relating to any system, services and that you will execute such documents as may be necessary to secure to the Company.

PROBATION & CONFIRMATION:

The first six months of your employment from the date of joining will be regarded as a probationary period. At the end of the probation period, if your performance needs to improve, then your probation period may be extended in writing for a further period of two months at the discretion of the Departmental Head. During the extended probation period, if your performance is still found
unsatisfactory by your departmental Head, then your service will be terminated as provided hereunder.

If you would like to leave during the probation period, you can do so by giving a 15-day notice period in writing. If you do not serve the notice period, all your Full & Final dues will be adjusted against your notice period

During probation/extended probation period, your services may be terminated by giving one week’s notice period or Same day

On satisfactory completion of your probation period, your service will be confirmed in writing

PLACE of POSTING:

You will be based at Sh N B1/A Ground Floor, Mahavir, Ngr, Deepak Hospital, Mira Road, Thane-401107 Maharashtra. At the discretion of the management, your services may be transferred to any department or location of the Organization (India / Abroad) existing at present or that may be formed/ acquired in future.

RESPONSIBILITY:

You will attend to all the urgent jobs assigned to you by the Company, irrespective of the working hours.

You will be responsible for protecting the interests of the Company in all the transactions entered by you directly or through an agent/dealer in your area of work, including the recovery of dues of the Company.

VISITS:

You could be required to travel outside the office as per the requirements of the Organization & as directed by your superior. Refusal / Failure without a valid justification shall be viewed seriously.

LEAVE:

You will be eligible to avail of the leave benefits as governed by the rules and regulations of the Organization.

COMPENSATION PROGRESSION:

Future increases in your compensation and future projects in the company shall be based on demonstrated results, such as your efficiency, hard work, smart work, regularity in attendance, sincerity, good conduct, and such other relevant factors that you will be reviewed periodically as per the policy of the Company.

SEPARATION:

On confirmation, your services may be terminated by giving 7 days’ notice or payment in lieu of 7 days’ notice

In the event of resignation after the probation period, you are bound by a 30-day notice period. The Organization reserves the right to make you serve the full notice period or relieve you from the services earlier by recovering the shortfall in the notice period
If you remain absent for more than 4 consecutive working days, without prior sanction of leave, or overstay the sanctioned leave for 4 consecutive working days, it would be treated as a voluntary abandonment of services followed by the termination of your services with immediate effect.
During your employment with the Company, if at any point in time, you are found guilty of misconduct or indulging in any unlawful activities including breaching any of the terms and conditions of the letter or being found dishonest, committing fraud, misuse of Company property or accepting any commission or gratification or discounts, etc., from any person associated with Company’s agent/ associate, your employment is liable to be terminated, without any notice or payment in lieu of notice thereof.

In the event of termination or resignation, the Full and Final Settlement will be disbursed by or on 45 days from the date of Exit

RETIREMENT:
You shall retire from the services of the Company on attaining the age of 58 years.

SETTLEMENT OF DUES:
Settlement of dues would be subject to the completion of exit formalities and complete handover of responsibilities to the person nominated by the Organization.

GENERAL:

During your employment with Company, you shall not engage in or seek employment, or join or associate directly or indirectly with any competing person or Company or a proposed venture, whether as a principal, agent, partner or employee or in any other capacity, either full-time or part-time.

You will devote your full attention & time exclusively to the Company’s work & the duties entrusted on you from time to time and would not work for or be associated in any capacity with any other person or business or Company.

In case of any dispute regarding this appointment, the Courts in Mumbai would have the final jurisdiction.

Your continuation in the services of the Company will be subject to your physical fitness as may be required for the position you may hold. Consequently, you will be required to go through a medical test and examination from time to time as may be deemed necessary by the Company.

This appointment is made on the understanding that the information and the certificates provided are genuine and Bonafide. At any time in future, if it is found that the information provided is false, then your services are liable for termination without notice/compensation.

Please sign a copy of this letter as a token of acceptance, agreeing to all the terms and conditions mentioned in the letter.

Yours truly,
For Jaikalki Technology Pvt Ltd,	I agree and accept the terms of employment

[ABC]	     Signature
Director	  {{full_name}}
Annexure ‘A’

name: Leave Policy 2025
body:
Leave Policy

Purpose:
The purpose of this Leave Policy is to define the types of leave available to employees and to establish clear guidelines for availing and managing leave in a fair and consistent manner. The policy aims to promote a healthy work-life balance while ensuring smooth business operations.

Scope:
This policy applies to all regular, full-time, and probationary employees of the company. Contractual or temporary staff may be governed by separate agreements or statutory provisions, as applicable.
Types of Leaves:
Casual Leave (CL):
Employees will get 6 days per calendar year, effective from the date of joining.
Casual Leave is intended for short-term personal needs or unforeseen circumstances.
A maximum of 3 consecutive days of Casual Leave may be taken at a time.
Unused Casual Leave will not be carried forward to the next year and cannot be encashed.

Sick Leave (SL):
Employees will get 8 days per calendar year, effective from the date of joining.
Sick Leave can be availed in case of illness, medical emergencies, or injury.
A medical certificate is required to approve the sick leave.
Unused sick leave will not be carried forward to the next year and cannot be encashed.

Privilege Leave (PL):
Privilege Leave/ Paid Leave is applicable only after confirmation of employment.
Employees earn 1 day of PL for every 20 days of work.
PL is calculated based on the number of days worked, including week-offs and public holidays.
If an employee has fewer than 20 present days in a month, PL for that month lapses.
Earned Leave can be availed for planned vacations or personal commitments.
Unused PL can be carried forward 80% to the next financial year.
Earned Leave may be encashed as per company policy and statutory guidelines.

Planned Leaves:
Planned leaves exceeding 3 days must be informed 7 days in advance in writing.

Leave Without Pay (LWP):
If an employee has exhausted all eligible leaves, any additional absence will be treated as Leave Without Pay.
LWP requires prior approval from the reporting manager or HR.
LWP will not count toward service continuity or leave accrual.

Sandwich Leave:

Definition:
The Sandwich Leave Policy applies when an employee’s leave period includes weekly offs (Saturday/Sunday) or company-declared holidays between two leave dates. In such cases, the weekly off/holiday will also be counted as part of the total leave duration.

Examples
If an employee applies for leave on Friday and Monday, then Saturday and Sunday will also be counted as leave days, making the total leave count 4 days.
If an employee applies for leave from Thursday to Monday, then the weekend (Saturday and Sunday) will be included, totalling 5 days of leave.
If an employee takes leave before and after a public holiday, that holiday will also be considered as a leave day.

Exceptions
If the employee is on official duty or approved work travel during the holiday period, the sandwich rule will not apply.
The company reserves the right to relax this rule in exceptional or medical cases, at the discretion of HR and Management.

Maternity Leave:
Female employees are entitled to 26 weeks (182 days) of paid Maternity Leave as per the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017.
The leave can be availed 8 weeks before and 18 weeks after delivery.
For the third child, Maternity Leave entitlement is 12 weeks.
Employees adopting a child below 3 months of age are entitled to 12 weeks of leave from the date of adoption.

Paternity Leave:
Male employees are entitled to 5 days of paid Paternity Leave, which can be availed within 3 months from the date of childbirth.

Leave Application Procedure:
All leave requests must be submitted through the company’s HR software or official email to the reporting manager and HR.
Approval of leave is subject to business requirements and managerial discretion.
In case of emergencies, employees must inform their reporting manager at the earliest possible time.
Unauthorised absence for 3 consecutive working days without intimation may be treated as absconding, leading to disciplinary action.
Attendance Expectation:
Employees are encouraged to maintain 90% attendance throughout the year.

Leave Encashment:
Only Privilege Leave is eligible for encashment as per company policy and statutory guidelines.
Encashment will be processed during full and final settlement or as approved by management.

Public Holidays – 2025
The company observes a list of official public holidays as communicated at the start of each calendar year.
Weekly offs and holidays are not counted as leave unless they fall under the Sandwich Leave rule.

The following are designated public holidays for all employees:

General Guidelines:
Leave is a privilege, not a right, and must be approved before being availed.
Employees should ensure that their absence does not disrupt workflow.
Any misuse, falsification, or repeated unapproved absence will result in disciplinary action.
The company reserves the right to modify, update, or withdraw this policy at any time.
